agb.title: General Terms and Conditions for Insurance Brokers
agb.subtitle: Healio GmbH – General Terms and Conditions for Insurance Brokers.
agb.section1Title: 1. Subject of Contract per Broker Agreement
agb.section1p1: The insurance broker agreement, incorporating these General Terms and Conditions (GTC), applies only to the private-law insurance contracts expressly named in the broker agreement for which brokerage services were requested or management was transferred to the broker.
agb.section1p2: It may be separately agreed that the mandate extends to insurance relationships existing at the time of conclusion of this agreement.
agb.section1p3: No other or further obligation to act or advise exists beyond the scope defined herein.
agb.section1p4: If the client concludes an insurance contract through another intermediary after the conclusion of this agreement, the present broker agreement does not extend to that contract.
agb.section1p5: If the client wishes the broker to arrange an additional insurance contract after conclusion of the present broker agreement, the present broker agreement also extends to this advice.
agb.section1p6: This insurance broker agreement relates only to the advice on and brokerage of insurance contracts pursuant to §34d GewO.
agb.section2Text: The client is obligated to cooperate, in particular to provide truthful information promptly and completely.
agb.section3Text: The broker assumes liability for the proper fulfilment of duties within the framework of statutory provisions.

status.title: Type of activity, permission and intermediary register
status.type: Healio GmbH is registered with the Hamburg Chamber of Commerce as an insurance broker with permission pursuant to section 34d(1) of the German Trade Regulation Act (GewO) and is entered in the intermediary register under registration number D-C1LE-OVLQH-98. The entry can be verified at www.vermittlerregister.info.
status.registryOfficeTitle: Joint register office pursuant to section 11a GewO

advice.title: Advice and type of remuneration
advice.offered: Healio GmbH offers advice in connection with the brokerage of insurance contracts.
advice.remuneration: For brokering and servicing insurance contracts, Healio GmbH exclusively receives commission or brokerage from the insurance company. This remuneration is included in the insurance premium.
advice.noOtherRemuneration: Customers do not pay any separate direct remuneration to Healio GmbH. No additional remuneration, other benefits or combination of different types of remuneration is received.

participations.title: Shareholdings
participations.outbound: Healio GmbH has no direct or indirect shareholding in the voting rights or capital of any insurance company.
participations.inbound: No insurance company or parent company of an insurance company has any direct or indirect shareholding in the voting rights or capital of Healio GmbH.

advisoryBasis.title: Basis of advice pursuant to section 60 VVG
advisoryBasis.lead: Section 60 VVG governs the basis of our advice, not the status-related initial information.
advisoryBasis.text: As an insurance broker, we generally base our recommendation on a sufficient number of insurance contracts and insurers available on the market, allowing us to recommend, on the basis of professional criteria, which contract is suitable to meet your needs.
advisoryBasis.restricted: If, in an individual case, a recommendation is not based on a sufficient breadth of the market, we will expressly inform you before you submit your contractual declaration about the restricted selection of insurers and contracts, the market and information basis used and the insurers taken into account.

erstinformation.closing: This information is provided free of charge. Please retain it for your records. Your browser's print function allows you to print the page or save it as a PDF.
